name: TileShift
description: Gen 3 world art for Gen 1/2, with selectable trees, flowers, grass and water, Random and Mixed modes, and a refined Sprout Tower. Complete Pallet, Viridian City, Route 1, Viridian Forest, Gen 1 caves, New Bark, Cherrygrove, Violet, Azalea, Mahogany, Cianwood, Olivine, Ecruteak, Blackthorn, Lake of Rage, Mt. Silver Outside and Gen 2 Pallet backgrounds. Other maps remain in progress.
